data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $4.439m. During 2024 the Syndicate recorded a gross strengthening (increase) in prior year claim provisions of $1.824m (c.41.1% of opening gross claims), driven by adverse development largely related to larger claims (notably fires at warehouse/storage locations) affecting the cargo/transport portfolio. The movement is recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation under 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions'.
raw_causal_phrases: Some larger claims have been observed, mainly from fires at warehouse storage locations.
2024 saw claims activity increase as the 2023 and 2024 years' of account started to earn through.
Loss ratios remain below plan, with attritional claims lower expected for both years.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional/currency (USD). Opening gross claims and the prior year movement are taken directly from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table ('Claims outstanding') where the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' shows a gross movement of $1,824k. The claims development triangle is available in the notes and was not distorted by any disclosed RITC. Some causal inferences (warehouse fires) are from narrative; specific quantitative splits by LOB are not provided so LOB allocation is indicative.
